mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oms_order WHERE id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pms_sku_stock SET lock_stock = COALESCE(lock_stock, 0) + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{skuId} AND stock - COALESCE(lock_stock, 0) >= #{quantity}
UPDATE ums_member SET integration = COALESCE(integration, 0) + #{delta} WHERE id = #{memberId} AND COALESCE(integration, 0) + #{delta} >= 0

UPDATE sms_coupon_history SET use_status = 1, use_time = NOW(), order_id = #{order.id}, order_sn = #{order.orderSn} WHERE member_id = #{order.memberId} AND coupon_id = #{order.couponId} AND use_status = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

UPDATE sms_coupon_history SET use_status = 0, use_time = NULL, order_id = NULL, order_sn = NULL WHERE member_id = #{order.memberId} AND coupon_id = #{order.couponId} AND use_status = 1 AND order_id = #{order.id}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_sn, o.coupon_id, o.integration, o.member_id, ot.id ot_id, ot.product_name ot_product_name, ot.product_sku_id ot_product_sku_id, ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code, ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.id, o.order_sn, o.coupon_id, o.integration, o.member_id, o.use_integration, ot.id ot_id, ot.product_name ot_product_name, ot.product_sku_id ot_product_sku_id, ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code, ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id WHERE o.status = 0 AND o.delete_status = 0 AND o.create_time < date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -#{minute} MINUTE);
